texts.tray.title: QNC AI
texts.tray.delete_base_ask:
Delete the Ingest base {base}?

Its clips, posters, filmstrips, waves and analyses go. The card is not touched.
texts.tray.delete_base_none: There is no Ingest base to delete.
texts.tray.delete_base_not_owner:
Ingest base {base} was made by {user} on {computer}.

The base is shared: only who made it, or the administrator (QNC AI run as administrator), may delete it.
texts.tray.delete_base_no_owner:
Ingest base {base} does not say who made it.

Only the administrator (QNC AI run as administrator) may delete it.
texts.tray.card_known:
Card {card} is already imported into Ingest base {base} ({had} clips).

No new clips: nothing is imported again.

Open your projects and go on with one of them?
texts.projects.title: QNC AI: Projects
texts.tray.card_known_ask:
Card {card} is already imported into Ingest base {base} ({had} clips), and it has {new} new clips.

Yes: add the new clips to base {base}.
No: a new Ingest base with only the new clips.
Cancel: nothing is imported.

Clips already imported are not imported again.

texts.new_project.title: QNC AI: New project
texts.new_project.offer_message: The project {name} exists. The clips of this card can go on it or into a new project.

texts.card_ingest.selecting: Reading the clips of the card
texts.card_ingest.statements: {statements} clips are statements (A1): the AI shots leave them alone.
texts.card_ingest.failed: {failed} clips not imported (the card was out): put the card back and the import goes on.
texts.card_ingest.stop_hint: Stop this: it is not needed. What is made stays.
texts.tray.put_back:
Put card {card} back: it is in use.

The card was taken out without ejecting it, and the story still needs it. To take a card out, use "Eject" in the QNC AI menu.
texts.tray.eject_in_use:
Card {card} is in use (player, import) and was not ejected.

Close what uses it and try again.
